title: Before Dana was an agent: your exam and the road to a license
summary: Follow Dana from study desk to license: how PSI 16-81 is scored, the course and application windows, test-day rules, pacing and four tough calls.
objectives: Know the format: 150 scored items, 2.5 hours, 74% (111 right) to pass
Use the section weights and a pacing plan to aim your study and your time
Follow the steps and deadlines to a license, and the test-day rules
Study daily with today's session, recall first and confidence ratings

scenes.title: Before Dana was an agent: your exam and the road to a license
scenes.subtitle: PSI Series 16-81: scoring, the steps to a Michigan producer license, test-day rules and pacing

beats.text: This is Dana, before she was anyone's agent. First, she must pass the same exam you're facing.
beats.say: This is Dana, before she was anyone's agent. First, she must pass the same exam you're facing.

beats.text: Me, a licensed agent? Let's do this!
beats.say: Me, a licensed agent? Let's do this!

scenes.title: Dana's target: the cut score
scenes.src: PSI CIB eff. 6/10/2025, p.9; DIFS Insurance Examination Cut Scores PDF (eff. 5/1/2020); PSI 16-81 content outline
scenes.plain: The passing line: the score you must reach to pass the exam.
scenes.example: Like the height line at a ride: reach it and you're on. Dana's line is 74% of 150 items: 111 right, so she can miss up to 39.
scenes.exam: Passing depends on how many you get right. A blank can't be right, so answer every item.

beats.text: Dana's first lesson: the cut score, the passing line you must reach.
beats.say: Dana's first lesson: the cut score, the passing line you must reach.

beats.text: Her exam, PSI Series 16-81, has 150 scored items and 2.5 hours. The cut score is 74%.
beats.say: Her exam, P S I Series sixteen eighty-one, has one hundred fifty scored items and two point five hours. The cut score is seventy-four percent.

beats.text: That's 111 right answers. She can miss up to 39 and still pass.
beats.say: That's one hundred eleven right answers. She can miss up to thirty-nine and still pass.

scenes.title: Where the 150 items come from
scenes.src: PSI Michigan P&C Producer/Solicitor 16-81 content outline (Sept 2021): section weights

spots.label: P&C Insurance Basics
spots.text: 20% of the exam, or 30 items. The biggest section of all.

spots.label: Homeowners and Auto
spots.text: 15% each, or 22 items each. Tied for second place.

spots.label: The small four
spots.text: Businessowners 6% (9 items), Workers' Comp 5% (8), Other Coverages 4% (6), Dwelling 2.5% (4). Together: 17.5%, or 27 items.

beats.text: The outline splits the 150 items into ten sections. Which carry the most?
beats.say: The outline splits the one hundred fifty items into ten sections. Which carry the most?

beats.text: Tap each glowing picture.
beats.say: Tap each glowing picture.

reveal.text: Basics is the biggest: 20%, or 30 items. Homeowners and Auto tie for second, at 22 each.
reveal.say: Basics is the biggest: twenty percent, or thirty items. Homeowners and Auto tie for second, at twenty-two each.

reveal.text: The four smallest still add up to 27 items. Don't skip them.
reveal.say: The four smallest still add up to twenty-seven items. Don't skip them.

scenes.title: Thirty hours into a 40-hour course
scenes.src: MCL 500.1204(1),(2), 500.1204a(1)(b), 500.1204c(2); PSI CIB eff. 6/10/2025, p.2; DIFS Pre-licensing Education FAQ

beats.text: In Michigan, the exam comes after prelicensing education, a required course: 40 hours for combined property and casualty.
beats.say: In Michigan, the exam comes after prelicensing education, a required course: forty hours for combined property and casualty.

beats.text: Thirty hours in, she's itching to test right away. What should Dana do?
beats.say: Thirty hours in, she's itching to test right away. What should Dana do?

options.label: Test right away, finish the course later
options.fail: Exam results are invalidated if prelicensing education wasn't completed before the exam.

beats.text: She passes! But with the course unfinished, her results are invalidated.
beats.say: She passes! But with the course unfinished, her results are invalidated.

options.label: Ask for a waiver: her real estate license
options.fail: Real estate isn't on the waiver list. CPCU is (ask in writing, granted before scheduling), and so is a producer license in the past 12 months.

beats.text: Sorry, real estate isn't on the waiver list.
beats.say: Sorry, real estate isn't on the waiver list.

beats.text: Nice try. A designation like CPCU would be.
beats.say: Nice try. A designation like C P C U would be.

draw.text: Real estate isn't on the waiver list.

options.label: Finish all 40 hours, then book the exam
options.win: Prelicensing education comes first. The certificate is valid for 12 months from completion: pass the exam within that window.

beats.text: Her course certificate is good for 12 months: she must pass inside that window.
beats.say: Her course certificate is good for twelve months: she must pass inside that window.

reveal.text: Course first, or even a pass is invalidated. A designation like CPCU can earn a course waiver, requested in writing and granted before scheduling.
reveal.say: Course first, or even a pass is invalidated. A designation like C P C U can earn a course waiver, requested in writing and granted before scheduling.

reveal.text: Watch out: 20 hours covers one line, like property; 24 is continuing education, once you're licensed.
reveal.say: Watch out: twenty hours covers one line, like property; twenty-four is continuing education, once you're licensed.

scenes.title: Dana applies and books her seat
scenes.src: DIFS resident producer page; MCL 500.1201, 500.1205(1), 500.1239(1)(d),(e); PSI CIB 6/10/2025, p.2-5 (fees may change)

draw.text: No felony in the 10 years before applying
Violence, criminal sexual conduct or financial crime: any date

beats.text: Next, Dana applies online through NIPR. In Michigan, a producer, meaning an agent, pays $10 to apply, plus $5 for the transaction.
beats.say: Next, Dana applies online through N I P R. In Michigan, a producer, meaning an agent, pays ten dollars to apply, plus five dollars for the transaction.

beats.text: She must be at least 18. Picture a rearview mirror showing the 10 years before she applies: a felony conviction in it means no license. A felony involving violence, criminal sexual conduct or financial crime never leaves it.
beats.say: She must be at least eighteen. Picture a rearview mirror showing the ten years before she applies: a felony conviction in it means no license. A felony involving violence, criminal sexual conduct or financial crime never leaves it.

beats.text: Her application is good for 180 days: she must pass inside that window. Then she registers with PSI: $41, not refundable.
beats.say: Her application is good for one hundred eighty days: she must pass inside that window. Then she registers with P S I: forty-one dollars, not refundable.

beats.text: Cancel or reschedule at least 2 days ahead, or lose the fee. A passing score stays valid for 12 months.
beats.say: Cancel or reschedule at least two days ahead, or lose the fee. A passing score stays valid for twelve months.

scenes.q: Dana's NIPR producer license application was just entered into the DIFS database. How long does she have to pass the exam?
scenes.why: A resident producer application is valid 180 days from entry into the DIFS database. After that, she needs a new application and fee.

beats.text: Quick check: DIFS, Michigan's insurance department, just entered her application. How long does she have to pass?
beats.say: Quick check: D I F S, Michigan's insurance department, just entered her application. How long does she have to pass?

reveal.text: 180 days. Then it's a new application and fee. Twelve months is for the course certificate and a passing score.
reveal.say: One hundred eighty days. Then it's a new application and fee. Twelve months is for the course certificate and a passing score.

scenes.title: How Dana studied: this app
scenes.src: Study guide: How to study (Roediger & Karpicke 2006; Cepeda et al. 2006; Butler et al. 2011); app labels

beats.text: Seat booked, Dana studies with this app. Every day, she taps Start today's session first.
beats.say: Seat booked, Dana studies with this app. Every day, she taps Start today's session first.

beats.text: Misses come back next session; right answers, after growing gaps. Then she adds new material, roughly by weight.
beats.say: Misses come back next session; right answers, after growing gaps. Then she adds new material, roughly by weight.

beats.text: She answers from memory, not by rereading: in Practice, Recall first hides the choices.
beats.say: She answers from memory, not by rereading: in Practice, Recall first hides the choices.

beats.text: She mixes topics with All sections, weighted like the exam. With Rate how sure I am on, misses she marked Sure come back first.
beats.say: She mixes topics with All sections, weighted like the exam. With Rate how sure I am on, misses she marked Sure come back first.

scenes.title: Exam morning in Grand Rapids
scenes.src: PSI CIB eff. 6/10/2025, p.5-6; DIFS Remote Examination Discontinuance (June 9, 2025)

beats.text: Exam day! Michigan testing is in person only, at a PSI test center. Dana's is in Grand Rapids, at 9. When should she arrive?
beats.say: Exam day! Michigan testing is in person only, at a P S I test center. Dana's is in Grand Rapids, at nine. When should she arrive?

options.label: Walk in right at 9. Why wait around?
options.fail: Not checked in by your start time? You can't test, and you lose your fee.

beats.text: Too late: she isn't checked in by her start time. She can't test, and loses her fee.
beats.say: Too late: she isn't checked in by her start time. She can't test, and loses her fee.

options.label: Get there 30 minutes early
options.win: PSI says arrive 30 minutes early. Not checked in by your start time? You can't test, and you lose your fee.

beats.text: Smart. She checks in with time to spare.
beats.say: Smart. She checks in with time to spare.

options.label: Oversleep, then email PSI to reschedule
options.fail: Cancel or reschedule at least 2 days before the exam, and not by voicemail or email. Missing the exam forfeits the fee.

beats.text: She oversleeps. Email doesn't count, and changes need 2 days' notice anyway. Her fee is gone.
beats.say: She oversleeps. Email doesn't count, and changes need two days' notice anyway. Her fee is gone.

reveal.text: Arrive 30 minutes early; change plans at least 2 days ahead.
reveal.say: Arrive thirty minutes early; change plans at least two days ahead.

scenes.title: What goes into the exam room?
scenes.src: PSI CIB eff. 6/10/2025, p.6-7; MCL 500.1239(2); study guide, test-day strategy

beats.text: Her friend Tony, who owns a Detroit pizza place, brought a lucky pizza. What does Dana bring into the exam room?
beats.say: Her friend Tony, who owns a Detroit pizza place, brought a lucky pizza. What does Dana bring into the exam room?

options.label: Phone and smartwatch, just in case
options.fail: Phones, electronic watches and handheld calculators aren't allowed in the exam.

beats.text: Not allowed in here!
beats.say: Not allowed in here!

beats.text: Phones and electronic watches stay out of the exam.
beats.say: Phones and electronic watches stay out of the exam.

options.label: A cheat sheet up her sleeve
options.fail: No notes or reference materials. In Michigan, using notes during the licensing exam is a ground on which the insurance director may refuse a license.

beats.text: In Michigan, using notes during the exam is a reason the insurance director may refuse a license.
beats.say: In Michigan, using notes during the exam is a reason the insurance director may refuse a license.

options.label: Tony's lucky pizza and a soda
options.fail: Food and drinks aren't allowed in the exam. Not even lucky pizza.

beats.text: But it's lucky pizza!
beats.say: But it's lucky pizza!

beats.text: Sorry, Tony. Food and drinks aren't allowed.
beats.say: Sorry, Tony. Food and drinks aren't allowed.

options.label: Just her valid driver's license
options.win: One valid, unexpired, government-issued ID with photo and signature, in your registered name, like a state driver's license or US passport.

beats.text: Perfect: one valid, unexpired government photo ID with her signature, in her registered name.
beats.say: Perfect: one valid, unexpired government photo I D with her signature, in her registered name.

reveal.text: Leave behind phones, electronic watches, handheld calculators, notes, food and drinks. You get scratch paper and a pencil, so practice math by hand.
reveal.say: Leave behind phones, electronic watches, handheld calculators, notes, food and drinks. You get scratch paper and a pencil, so practice math by hand.

scenes.title: Some items don't count
scenes.src: PSI CIB eff. 6/10/2025, p.8; study guide, test-day strategy (pace)
scenes.plain: A question PSI is trying out. It isn't scored, but it still uses your exam time.
scenes.example: Like a test slice Tony adds to your order: it's not on the bill, but eating it still takes time.
scenes.exam: PSI may add 1 to 10, generally about 10% of the questions. The bulletin doesn't say they're marked: treat every item as scored.

beats.text: Her exam may include experimental items: questions PSI is trying out. They aren't scored, but they use exam time.
beats.say: Her exam may include experimental items: questions P S I is trying out. They aren't scored, but they use exam time.

beats.text: Like a test slice Tony adds to your order: not on the bill, but it takes time to eat.
beats.say: Like a test slice Tony adds to your order: not on the bill, but it takes time to eat.

beats.text: There may be one to ten. Unlike Tony's slice, they may not stand out, so treat every item as scored.
beats.say: There may be one to ten. Unlike Tony's slice, they may not stand out, so treat every item as scored.

scenes.title: Dana's pacing plan
scenes.src: PSI CIB eff. 6/10/2025, p.8; study guide, test-day strategy (pace, tutorial)

draw.text: Tutorial: up to 15 min, not on the clock
Plan: up to about 165 items, about 50 seconds each

beats.text: First, the tutorial: up to 15 minutes, and it doesn't count toward exam time.
beats.say: First, the tutorial: up to fifteen minutes, and it doesn't count toward exam time.

beats.text: Then the clock: 150 minutes, shown as minutes left. To be safe, she adds 10%: up to about 165 items, about 50 seconds each.
beats.say: Then the clock: one hundred fifty minutes, shown as minutes left. To be safe, she adds ten percent: up to about one hundred sixty-five items, about fifty seconds each.

beats.text: About 60 done at 100 minutes left, and 120 at 50. Finishing all 165 leaves about 12 minutes to go back.
beats.say: About sixty done at one hundred minutes left, and one hundred twenty at fifty. Finishing all one hundred sixty-five leaves about twelve minutes to go back.

scenes.title: Question 37 has Dana stumped
scenes.src: PSI CIB eff. 6/10/2025, p.8; PSI 16-81 outline; study guide, test-day strategy

beats.text: Dana reads the last line first, to see what's asked. It's an EXCEPT item: three choices fit, and she needs the one that doesn't.
beats.say: Dana reads the last line first, to see what's asked. It's an except item: three choices fit, and she needs the one that doesn't.

beats.text: Ugh. I've ruled out A and C. B or D? The clock is ticking!
beats.say: Ugh. I've ruled out A and C. B or D? The clock is ticking!

options.label: Leave it blank and come back later
options.fail: Never leave a blank: passing depends on how many you get right, and a blank can't be right.

beats.text: Time runs out before she gets back. A blank can't be right: a sure miss.
beats.say: Time runs out before she gets back. A blank can't be right: a sure miss.

options.label: Stare at it until she's sure
options.fail: Plan about 50 seconds per item. Stuck? Make your best guess, note the number, and move on.

beats.text: Ten minutes later, she's still staring: at about 50 seconds an item, that's time for 12 items.
beats.say: Ten minutes later, she's still staring: at about fifty seconds an item, that's time for twelve items.

options.label: Pick her best guess, jot 37, move on
options.win: Eliminate, pick your best answer, note the item number on scratch paper, and move on. You can change answers while time remains.

beats.text: She picks D, her best guess, jots 37 on scratch paper and moves on.
beats.say: She picks D, her best guess, jots thirty-seven on scratch paper and moves on.

reveal.text: She can change any answer while time remains. Never leave a blank.
reveal.say: She can change any answer while time remains. Never leave a blank.

scenes.title: Smart move or trap?
scenes.src: PSI CIB eff. 6/10/2025, p.5-8; study guide, test-day strategy

cards.text: Dana's state driver's license expired last month. It's the only ID she brings.
cards.why: PSI requires one valid, unexpired, government-issued ID with photo and signature. Without proper ID, you lose your fee.

cards.text: On an EXCEPT item, she picks the first choice that fits the question.
cards.why: In an EXCEPT item, three choices fit the question. You want the one that doesn't. Watch for NOT items the same way.

cards.text: She takes the full on-screen tutorial, though she's worried about time.
cards.why: The tutorial, up to 15 minutes, doesn't count toward exam time. Its sample questions let her practice.

cards.text: She brings a valid US passport in the name she registered under.
cards.why: A valid US passport is an accepted government-issued ID with photo and signature.

cards.text: She brings a bank card with her photo and signature as her ID.
cards.why: A bank card isn't government-issued. PSI needs a valid, unexpired, government-issued ID with photo and signature.

cards.text: Her ID is valid, but it shows a different name than the one she registered under.
cards.why: The first and last name on your ID must match the name you registered under.

beats.text: Your turn: smart move or trap? Swipe through Dana's exam day.
beats.say: Your turn: smart move or trap? Swipe through Dana's exam day.

reveal.text: Only a valid government photo ID with your signature, in your registered name, gets you in. Use the tutorial; read EXCEPT items carefully.
reveal.say: Only a valid government photo I D with your signature, in your registered name, gets you in. Use the tutorial; read except items carefully.

items: 150 scored items, 2.5 hours; 74%, or 111 right, to pass
Basics is biggest; Homeowners and Auto next. Study by weight
Course first (40 hours); pass within 180 days of applying
Arrive 30 minutes early with one valid government photo ID
Eliminate, guess, note, move on. Never leave a blank

beats.text: And Dana? She passed! Remember: 150 items, 74% to pass, Basics weighs most.
beats.say: And Dana? She passed! Remember: one hundred fifty items, seventy-four percent to pass, Basics weighs most.

beats.text: Course first, pass within 180 days of applying, arrive 30 minutes early with valid ID, and never leave a blank.
beats.say: Course first, pass within one hundred eighty days of applying, arrive thirty minutes early with valid I D, and never leave a blank.

beats.text: Now can we eat the pizza?
beats.say: Now can we eat the pizza?
